description: This PHP source file defines the FirehoseClient class within the Aws\Firehose namespace, which provides methods to interact with the Amazon Kinesis Firehose service, including creating, deleting, describing delivery streams, and managing encryption and tags.

classes.name: FirehoseClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon Kinesis Firehose service.

methods.name: describeDeliveryStream
methods.description: Retrieves details about a delivery stream.

methods.name: listTagsForDeliveryStream
methods.description: Lists tags for a delivery stream.

methods.name: putRecord
methods.description: Inserts a data record into delivery stream.

methods.name: putRecordBatch
methods.description: Inserts multiple data records into delivery stream.

methods.name: tagDeliveryStream
methods.description: Adds tags to a delivery stream.

methods.name: untagDeliveryStream
methods.description: Removes tags from a delivery stream.

methods.name: updateDestination
methods.description: Updates the specified destination for a delivery stream.
